title: Strict Base45 decoding
description: Engineering consequence of RFC 9285 The Base45 Data Encoding; HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation.

statements.label: Strict Base45 decoding
statements.requirement: The decoder SHALL reject characters outside the 45-character alphabet, a dangling single character, and triplets or pairs whose value overflows (above 65535, or above 255 for a trailing pair).
